setBoundary: Best friend’s birthday party timing vs when you ordered her birthday gift (photo album).

items.why: Mentions ordering a personalized photo album on the 15th of April for your best friend’s birthday.
Adds that the album arrived on the 20th “just in time for her party,” tying the 15th-of-April order to the birthday party event.
Gives the birthday party date explicitly as the 22nd of April for your best friend’s 30th birthday party.
